entries.text: DataFrame plan capture now yields canonical plan DAGs with top-level plan fingerprints on PySpark, LakeSail and Databricks (DataFrame mode) as well as DataFusion, instead of leaving PySpark plans as raw text; LakeSail DataFrame runs no longer abort on a missing capability entry; Pandas, Dask and cuDF report plan capture as unsupported rather than silently producing nothing; Polars stays raw text with no fingerprint; and result bundles whose measurement iterations share a stream now keep and reload one plan per iteration so show-plan and compare --include-plans work on DataFrame results.
